subject: Mercury Health — delegated access evidence & sample artifacts
messages:
From: Jane Li <jane.li@mercuryhealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@mercuryhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: scoped access evidence & SSO/SCIM samples for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking this on. Mercury Health is starting an expedited SIG submission and we need a focused package of artifacts scoped to identity and access. Can you confirm you can provide the following by 10/29?

- Example SAML assertion(s) for an interactive user (redacted) and a service account (full attributes)
- SCIM delta export for the last 90 days (or the maximum window you can easily produce)
- RBAC role map export and the current role->permission matrix (CSV fine)
- A list of role owners and how ownership is verified (we need point contacts for each privileged role)
- A short narrative (1 page) describing how least privilege is enforced on your platform
- A sample session/login trace for one user (redact PII if necessary)

We have a couple of follow-ups from the security team: they want to know whether SCIM deltas contain any PII and whether you can provide assertion timestamps and issuer fields in the SAML samples.

Attaching the SIG/CAIQ section we’re filling — feel free to drop links back to your bundle when you send artifacts.

Appreciate it,

Jane Li
Director, Vendor Security
Mercury Health

Attachments: Mercury_SIG_CAIX_section.pdf (referenced)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Li <jane.li@mercuryhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: scoped access evidence & SSO/SCIM samples for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything, with a couple of clarifications so we scope the redactions correctly:

1) SCIM delta window: our export tooling can produce a 90-day delta, but for sensitive customer data we typically redact email addresses in exported CSVs unless you need them. Do you require full emails or just opaque IDs?

2) SAML samples: we can provide one interactive-user assertion (with NameID redacted) and a service-account assertion showing full attributes and issuer/audience/timestamp fields.

3) Role owners: we will include a role_owner_matrix PDF that lists owner (name + corporate email) and owner verification method (manager approval / HR sync).

Proposed workback:
- 10/23: initial artifact drop (SAML samples + short narrative + role_owner_matrix)
- 10/26: SCIM deltas + RBAC CSV (first pass, redacted per your preference)
- 10/29: final delivery with session trace examples and any follow-up notes

I’ve attached a sample SAML assertion (redacted) so your team can confirm the format.

If that timeline works, we’ll proceed.

Best,

Mateo Alvarez
Technical Account Lead, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: sample_saml_assertion.xml (attachment)

---
Jane — forwarding Soojin and Irene to coordinate the exports.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jane Li <jane.li@mercuryhealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 14:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: scoped access evidence & SSO/SCIM samples for SIG/CAIQ

On Wed, Oct 21, 2026 at 9:03 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Jane — forwarding Soojin and Irene to coordinate the exports.

Thanks Mateo — I’ll own the exports

Notes on redaction and format:
- SCIM delta: can produce CSV with attributes: id, externalId, userName, active, meta.lastModified, groups. We will redact userName column to a hash if Mercury prefers. The delta will include create/update/delete events.
- RBAC export: we will provide rbac_role_map_v2.csv with columns: role_id, role_name, permissions_list, is_privileged (boolean).
- Session traces: we can produce a 7-day sample trace for a single user, including timestamp, action, source_ip, and session_id. We will remove full device/user_agent strings if needed.

Deliverables I’ll attach to the 10/23 drop (initial): sample_saml_assertion.xml, scim_delta_45days.csv (we’ll give 45 days now to iterate faster), and rbac_role_map_v2.csv. Final 90-day export targeted 10/26 if Jane confirms they need the full window.

Irene — can you add the short least-privilege narrative and confirm whether role_owner_matrix should include org-level approvals?

Thanks,

Soojin Lee
Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scim_delta_45days.csv (attachment), rbac_role_map_v2.csv (attachment)

From: Jane Li <jane.li@mercuryhealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@mercuryhealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: scoped access evidence & SSO/SCIM samples for SIG/CAIQ

Mateo / Soojin — thank you. A few clarifications from my side:

- For SCIM, mercury prefers opaque identifiers (hashed userName) in the CSV for sharing; we only need mapping evidence that syncs to your IdP for owner verification, not raw email addresses.
- Session traces: please do not include user email addresses in the trace we receive — session_id + hashed user id is fine. IPs are OK.
- Role owner matrix: we need the contact (name + corporate email) for all roles classified as privileged. The compliance team will follow up directly if any owner is unclear.

Also, are any of these exports subject to a separate data-usage agreement? We’d like to log the delivery to our internal GRC ticket (CH-9931).

If you can provide the initial drop on 10/23 with redactions as requested, we’ll review and open follow-ups.

Best,

Jane

---
Compliance Team note: Please confirm whether role_owner_matrix must include manager approvals or if HR sync is sufficient.

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Li <jane.li@mercuryhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: scoped access evidence & SSO/SCIM samples for SIG/CAIQ

Thanks Jane — we’ll proceed with the redaction rules you outlined. Finalizing the delivery plan here so it’s tracked: 

Action items (Redwood):
- 10/23 (initial): sample_saml_assertion.xml (redacted interactive assertion + full service-account assertion), scim_delta_45days.csv (userName hashed), rbac_role_map_v2.csv, role_owner_matrix.pdf (owners + verification method)
- 10/26: 90-day SCIM delta (if requested), extended session traces (7-day sample)
- 10/29: closure packet (includes narrative on least privilege, audit notes, and annotated mapping for SIG answers)

On the data-usage agreement: standard evidence exchange applies; we’ll include a short attestation header in the Drive bundle stating recipient use is limited to compliance review. If you need a signed DUA, flag it and I’ll route to legal.

Irene will attach the 1-page least-privilege narrative with the 10/23 drop. Thanks for the quick turnaround — we’ll post the initial bundle to: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/s/mercury-compliance/SIG-questionnaire

Best regards,

Mateo Alvarez
Technical Account Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments planned: sample_saml_assertion.xml, scim_delta_45days.csv, rbac_role_map_v2.csv, role_owner_matrix.pdf
